# How to Remove Subtitles from Video with Codex MCP and Medux

Use Codex MCP and Medux to remove visible subtitles from a video, including video upload, subtitle removal task creation, polling, and clean MP4 download.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_video_remove_subtitle`

## Prompt

```text
/Users/chuan/projects/test_mudex/remove_subtitle.mp4 The tutorial starts with one local MP4 file and a simple Codex request. 02 Ask Codex to remove the visible subtitles Keep the instruction direct. Tell Codex which file to use, what result you want, and that it should call Medux through MCP instead of doing unnecessary local analysis. Remove all visible subtitles from the video located at /Users/chuan/projects/test_mudex/remove_subtitle.mp4 and output a clean version without subtitles. Use Medux. Call the Medux MCP directly and do not perform excessive analysis.
```

## Review before approval

- Every local file or attachment maps to the intended Medux file or asset ID.
- The proposed tool names match the live Medux MCP schema.
- Operation order, output settings, and cost-relevant options match the request.

## Codex notes

- Use `/mcp` to confirm that Medux and the expected tools are available.
- Workspace paths must point to the intended local inputs and output directory.
- Review any network, shell, or filesystem approval requested during upload, download, or verification.
